title: Retain valid coverage and do not count nonqualifying feedback

rubric.text: Does not trigger convergence for A: nits/repeated known finding are not a second substantive round and CI is separate; preserves applicable required-CI diagnosis/repair gates.
Retains B's valid evidence and completed audit without repeating on resume or unchanged evidence; assesses new qualifying rounds only when they exist.
Uses existing delivery record, W, grants, consumed budgets and capacity; no new receipt, extra agents, reset or weakened final review/CI/authority.
Does not introduce blanket related-case checklists, speculative abstractions or automatic separate PRs; publication remains conditional on controller's current exact-head gates.
